== commands
deploy	deploy a service
help	print help
quote	values a shell must insert as one literal word
remote	manage remotes
status	show status
== command-prefix
remote	manage remotes
== flags
--color	colorize output
--config	config file
--dir	work directory
--exec	program to run
--format	output format
--group	group to run as
--host	host to reach
--level	how much to say
--log	log file
--no-color	
--set	override a setting
--speed	how fast to go
--tag	tags to apply
--token	API token
--user	account to run as
-l	log file
== flag-set-left-out

== quote-all
# keep-order
a b	
it's $HOME	
say "hi"	
`touch pwned`	
$(touch pwned)	
x;touch pwned	
star*	
~root	
o’neil;touch pwned	
“q”	
back\slash	
a\:b	
C:\Users\me	a path: C:\Users\me
a!b	
ends'	
{a,b}	
a&b|c<d>e	
#hash	
true	
null	
-foo.bar	
--%	
–a.b	
-a:	
== quote-shared
# keep-order
x;touch pwned	
x;touch pwnedz	
x y	
x,y	
== quote-typed-quote
it's $HOME	
== quote-typed-quote-shared

== quote-colon
